name: v0.3.40 — animation system + Guac-AI extensions + security pass
releaseNotes:
• Full animation system applied across 25 screens — count-up tweens on GuacScore/GuacMoney/Smash days, stagger fade-ins on every list (receipts, smashlist, inbox, stash, connections, etc.), shimmer skeletons during loading, tap-scale on buttons, slide-up on modals, cross-fade on tab changes.
• Mascot animations stretched (bounce 420→1100ms, wiggle 360→1200ms, pulse 800→1800ms, celebrate confetti 1100→2400ms with 24 dots + stronger gravity).
• Voice-to-receipt: tap the mic next to the camera on /receipts and speak. Web uses browser SpeechRecognition; mobile uses speech_to_text. Both surface a review step before save.
• Screenshot / online-order parsing: Amazon, Doordash, Uber Eats, Instacart, Walmart order-confirmation screenshots now parse cleanly. Camera button on mobile now opens a sheet — Take a photo OR Pick from gallery.
• PDF invoice parsing: Drop PDF button on /receipts; parses utility bills, subscription invoices, statements. Magic-byte sniff before pdf-parse touches the bytes.
• Smart auto-categorization: every save without a category gets re-run through Guac-AI. Admin button at /admin/cost to backfill historical receipts.
• Anomaly narratives: AnomaliesPanel now shows one-sentence AI explanations of WHY a receipt is anomalous, cached per (user, kind, bucket, period).
• Item tagging: receipt_items.ai_tag adds household/kid/health/treat/alcohol/food/beauty/tech tags as small chips.
• Security: fixed 3 issues caught by the adversarial review — parse-statement now requires auth + magic-byte sniff; parse-receipt now requires auth; reparse SSRF allow-list (only supabase + getguac hosts).
• Accessibility: animations respect prefers-reduced-motion (web) and MediaQuery.disableAnimations (mobile).
